thoughtProcess.title: Protect analytical access
thoughtProcess.body: Route natural-language questions through an agent that can inspect schema context without exposing private warehouse data on the portfolio.

thoughtProcess.title: Constrain SQL generation
thoughtProcess.body: Retrieve relevant schema, validate generated SQL, and use bounded correction when warehouse errors indicate a fixable query issue.

thoughtProcess.title: Reduce repeated latency
thoughtProcess.body: Cache schema and repeated query context so common KPI questions can move from expensive discovery to faster answer synthesis.

thoughtProcess.title: Return frontend-ready charts
thoughtProcess.body: When the user asks for a chart, emit a small chart_spec object that any portal charting library can render.

architecture.detail: Portal sends message and optional dashboard page context.
Classifies whether database access and visualization are needed.
Searches cached Redshift schema metadata for relevant tables and columns.
Generates read-only SQL using only verified schema context.
Checks SQL safety and retries bounded corrections when appropriate.
Summarizes query rows and prepares preview-safe response metadata.
Builds a minimal chart_spec when the query result is plottable.
